summary: US equities fell for a third session on Nov 17: S&P 500 -1%, Dow -1.6%, Nasdaq composite -0.7%, led by AI and software weakness. After the close NVIDIA reported Q3 FY27 revenue of $115.8B (+103% y/y) and EPS of $2.68 vs $2.48 consensus, and US stock futures rose. Brent fell 0.7% to $91.80 and is down about 16% over the past month. Bitcoin traded near $64-65k as a seven-session spot ETF outflow streak ended. No dated central-bank, gold, Ether, megacap (ex-NVDA) or European/Japanese index news was found in the window.

calendar.event: PBOC rate decision (per Investing.com central bank table)

items.headline: S&P 500 sinks 1%, Dow drops 1.6%, Nasdaq falls 0.7% as Nvidia and jittery AI stocks lead losses
items.note: Third straight down session; cash close precedes NVIDIA results.

items.headline: NVIDIA Q3 FY27 revenue $115.8B, up 103% y/y; Data Center $107.6B
items.note: EPS $2.68 vs $2.48 consensus per MarketBeat; release time taken from the scheduled 16:20 ET slot on forex.com's calendar.

items.headline: Stock futures rise as Nvidia gains on earnings beat and solid outlook
items.note: Overnight futures reversing part of the cash-session losses.

items.headline: Brent fell to 91.80 USD/Bbl on Nov 17, down 0.70%; down 16.21% over the past month
items.note: Oil is still falling from elevated levels; no OPEC or inventory news found in the window.

items.headline: Bitcoin at $65,016.66 at 8:15 a.m. ET, up about $1,004 from the prior morning
items.note: Price is stabilising near $64-65k; spot ETFs took $7.9M inflow after about $1.91B of outflows over seven sessions (Coinbase news).
